items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Now New York was something special, wasn't it, I mean there was a lot of -- there was -- for instance, you know James P. Johnson played a lot down at Cafe Society -- [INTERVIEWEE] Uh-huh, yes.

ctx.x: But they say she was like that. But at Cafe Society I found her to be entirely different. I found her to be very lovable person. Oh, as sweet as she could be. Always happy, you know, lovable person.

items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: I heard James P., and Willie the Lion Smith, and Fats Waller.

ctx.x: Who did you hear at these cutting contests?
I heard all of them. I heard James P., and Willie the Lion Smith, and Fats Waller.
